property_summary: For every fillable order, fillOrder must return the taker's (short-side) position id — the token minted to msg.sender, i.e. c.ownerOf(returnedId) == msg.sender always holds in C; the mutant returns the maker's order hash for short puts, so the returned id belongs to the maker instead.
change_summary: In the short-put early-return branch, return the original order hash instead of positionId.
